# An MCP session with the GoNoGo server (generated by `python -m eval.mcp_session`)

A scripted MCP client started `python -m gonogo.mcp_server` over stdio and made the calls below. The requests and responses are what went over the wire; long lists and strings are shortened, and each cut says how much was left out. No language model is in this loop: this is exactly what an agent such as Claude Desktop or Claude Code receives when [`.mcp.json.example`](../.mcp.json.example) is configured.

Server: `gonogo` 0.3.0, protocol `2025-06-18`. Tools (all read-only):

- `poll`: Readiness poll of F´ components: GO / NO-GO / INCOMPLETE requirement counts per component, from SDD requirements, REQUIREMENT() citations and the loaded CI unit-test run.
- `why`: Verdict of one requirement ID (e.g. HTH-001) with reason codes, the citing test cases of its component and their status in the CI run.
- `tests_to_rerun`: Before or after editing F´ code: unit-test cases to re-run for the changed files (paths relative to the F´ repository), components or port types, the requirements depending on them, GO verdicts pending re-run, and deployment connections for integration review.
- `suggest`: For a requirement no own test cites: the test bodies and helpers of its component that most likely verify it (Relate full-text index over test code, lifted to test cases over the call graph), a near-miss ID to rename if one exists, and the REQUIREMENT() line to add. Candidates for a reviewer, never evidence.
- `findings`: Traceability-hygiene findings: test files citing undefined requirement IDs, duplicate requirement IDs, requirements cited by tests of another component.
- `ask`: Ask a question about the F´ traceability graph; the answer includes the Cypher that produced it, or 'I don't know' when the graph does not cover it.

## A question in words, answered with its Cypher receipt

Request:

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 6, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "ask", "arguments": {"question": "Which requirements of Svc/TlmChan are not verified?"}}}
```

```json

 "status": "answered",
 "text": "Svc/TlmChan is INCOMPLETE: 4 of 6 requirements GO, 0 NO-GO, 2 incomplete. Not GO: TLC-005 INCOMPLETE (NO_CITING_TEST); TLC-006 INCOMPLETE (NO_CITING_TEST). This is a traceability verdict from repository text and CI results, not flight readiness.",
 "cypher": "CALL {\n  MATCH (x:Requirement)\n  WITH split(x.id, '@')[0] AS ref, count(*) AS n WHERE n > 1\n  RETURN collect(ref) AS dup_refs\n}\nMATCH (p:Part)-[:SATISFIES]->(r:Requirement)\nWITH dup_refs, p, r, split(r.id, '@')[0] AS ref\nOPTIONAL MATCH (r)-[:VERIFIED_BY]->(v:Verification)\nWITH dup_refs, p, r, ref, collect(DISTINCT v.method) AS methods\nOPTIONAL MATCH (r)<-[:CITES]-(cite_site)-[:TESTS]->(site_part:P... (2428 more characters)",
 "params": {
  "run": "run:45468869538",
  "accept_declared": false
 },
 "answer_ids": [
  "Svc/TlmChan"

}
```
